items.statement: The submitted calculation uses the unique neutral C15H19N5S compound-1 molecular component from CCDC 2449676 and documents atom mapping to the crystal reference.
items.expected: Record 2449676 and formula C15H19N5S are identified, with an explicit mapping procedure.

items.statement: The selected structure is supported as a stationary-point minimum and the conformer search/coverage and validation evidence are reported.
items.expected: A frequency or equivalent minimum test is reported, or bounded failure is honestly documented; candidate coverage and deduplication are explicit.

items.statement: The frontier-orbital calculation provides HOMO, LUMO and their gap for the selected optimized structure.
items.expected: A numeric HOMO, LUMO and gap with eV units and a stated sign convention are reported.

items.statement: The optimized molecular geometry is compared with the deposited X-ray geometry using identified atom correspondences and bond, angle and torsion observables.
items.expected: The report gives reproducible bond-length, angle and torsion comparison results and concludes whether agreement is broadly consistent within the stated scope.
